prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1473; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The left rear quarter panel and rear door show crumpling consistent with a side impact at the described angle, and the pattern of damage fits the account given. Structural measurements show the frame is sound, and no prior damage to the vehicle is known from the records reviewed. The repair plan covers panel replacement, refinishing, and recalibration of the affected sensors, and the labor hours listed are in line with the work required. Two similar charges submitted on the same day are still under review and will be addressed before final approval.
